newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-EMERICH JENEI NAMED CRAIOVA'S MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EMERICH JENEI NAMED CRAIOVA'S MANAGER.

text.p: Emerich Jenei, who coached Steaua Bucharest to victory in the European Cup in 1986, has been appointed manager of Romanian first division club Universitatea Craiova.
Club president Marcel Popescu said Jenei's had a one-year contract with the club.
Jenei, 59, admitted he deliberatly set out to play for a draw and penalties when Steaua met Barcelona in the European Cup Final 10 years ago in Seville.
His tactics worked as Steaua stifled Barcelona in a 0-0 draw then became the first club from a then socialist country to become European champions when they won the penalty shoot-out.
He later coached both Romania and Hungary and last year was technical director of Greek team Panionios.
